capabilities: Remove blank lines from selected text
Paste clipboard text without blank lines
extras: The README warns the plugin is currently broken on mobile due to a permissions change in v1.15.0.
intentEvidence: I started developing remove-newlines because copy-pasting quotes from PDFs into my Obsidian notes involved a lot of tedious clean-up work.
motivation: The author built it because copy-pasting quotes from PDFs into Obsidian notes involved a lot of tedious cleanup work.
problem: Pasted text from PDFs and web pages arrives with hard-wrapped lines and excessive blank lines that require tedious manual cleanup.
summary: Text cleanup plugin that removes newlines or blank lines from selections or pasted clipboard text.
